notes.title: Update 0.0.1.1 Arrived !
notes.notes:
Hello Mobsters!

UPDATE 0.0.1.1 finally arrived, I know we had promised until last year but we had several problems, including the Family Bussines project corrupted and we had to rush to solve this problem and to improve even more. Don became seriously ill in the last few months, but everything It's in perfect harmony now!


[h1]What's new in this update?[/h1]

Well, we finally had the addition of two new gamemodes: [b]KILL CONFIRMED AND FREE FOR ALL[/b], available for all maps!

As we also had the addition of a new map on Voodoo Business: [b]Route 666[/b]!


[h1]Improvements and fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed the issue of the warning menu not leaving the screen when played

[*]Fixed the issue of unstable servers

[*]Translation corrections

[*]Zombies hanging around some corners

[*]Fix Bots stuck in doors

[*]Improvement in widgets and fluidity of information on the screen

[*]Weapon balancing
[/list]


[h1]Where are the other additions?[/h1]


[b]We had a lot of losses due to the corruption of the [u]Family Business[/u][/b], so many things had to be removed, such as the map of the Smuggling Factory, which whether or not it interfered a lot with our production as it took months of work for something that had to be discarded. Family Business is stable in this update, but the project itself is unstable!

[h1]What will be done to correct the instability?[/h1]


It's finally where we wanted it to be, Famiy Business will be [u][b]REMAKE FROM SCRATCH[/b][/u], that's exactly what you read! We are going to redo it from scratch, so it may take a few months or years for the next update to come out, but don't be sad because it will be our cue to leave [b]ALPHA[/b] and enter [b]BETA[/b]! I'm sorry that this may be discouraging for some to have to wait longer for more content but it is because we will have the guarantee that the project will be stable and that means more frequent updates such as new mechanics and severe gameplay changes among them:

[list]
[*]Weapons will have procedural recoil and more complete and complex animations

[*]There will be different versions, you will have the freedom to jump, climb, throw grenades, etc

[*]System of climbing stairs and parkour on objects

[*]Perks in voodoo business were present as well as final on each map
[/list]

[b]MANY THINGS ARE ALREADY BEING PRODUCED AND WE GUARANTEE FAMILY BUSINESS WILL NOT STOP![/b]

[h1]FINAL CONSIDERATIONS[/h1]

Our studio apologizes for the delay, we want to hope that 2025 will be a wonderful year for all of you! We are at full steam working on a new horror project to finance more Family Business costs as well as informing you about the progress of the project! If you want to make a donation and help this new phase of Family Business, feel welcome to do so, just get in touch by email: [b]Contato.FamilyBusiness@gmail.com[/b]

We want to thank everyone for their loyalty throughout this time! If you have any questions or problems, don't hesitate to let us know!

We'll see you again soon!

Enjoy!

-Don

notes.title: Important Announcement !
notes.notes:
Hello mobsters!

You thought we wouldn't show up again, didn't you? Well, here we are, just to inform you that our update is very close to delivery, just wait a few more days! Like new game modes, huds, optimizations and maps!

This will be our last update of the year and probably one of the [u]last updates[/u] of [b]Family Business[/b], so I wanted to talk a little more about the issue of project development!

So, as everyone is already tired of knowing, [u][b]Family Business is an Indie project[/b][/u] and due to its size and ambition there are [u]several controversies[/u] in its production, including the issue of using [b]assets[/b]! But don't be alarmed when we say this will be the last update to Family Business because it's for the simple reason that: [b]LET'S LEAVE ALPHA[/b]!

Yes, that's right, we're going to leave [u]Alpha[/u] and prepare to enter our [b]BETA[/b], but we'll have to talk more on the day the update is released because we'll have a lot of changes in our projects ! That said, I just ask that you wait a little longer to receive our update! We have so many new things and ideas on the way that I'm sure you'll love!

So stay tuned for new information!

- Don

notes.title: Update Coming !
notes.notes:
Hello Mobsters!

I have great news for you! You asked for more content so here it goes:

[h3]What will we get in the 0.0.1.1 update?[/h3]

In addition to several bug fixes and optimizations, we will be adding [b]2 NEW MAPS[/b] :

[u][b]Smuggling Factory[/b][/u] - Getting weapons has never been so easy! Of course they are fake but what can you expect from mobsters, right?

[u][b]Route 666[/b][/u] - We are on a new route, a route towards hell! It's better to arm yourself because the bewitched are eager to have dinner!

In addition to these two maps, we will also have [b]2 NEW GAMEMODES[/b] :

[u][b]Kill Confirmed[/b][/u] - Kill your opponents and collect your dog tag to score!

[u][b]Free For All[/b][/u] - Nobody knows who the impostor is, so when in doubt, shoot everyone!

We will also have new gunplay mechanics! Since we are still producing the animations, at least this procedural shooting mechanic should help immerse you in the game!

[h3]Will we have more updates this year?[/h3]

I'm sorry to say [b]no[/b], we will just have patches to fix any issues that appear. But I guarantee that we will still have great news to share with you! However, it is still a secret document!

We have a lot of things in mind to do! Our focus now is to release this update as quickly as possible and then prepare the next one, which may be the biggest update in Family Business history! It will be a new phase, a new world, a new universe!

So now just wait! I thank everyone for their loyalty and patience!

- Don

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312675/811ea767bc624b40ef3797fd0f799e9e93e79d31.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello Mobsters !

As I said, here is the update [u][b]0.0.1.0[/b][/u] !

As everyone is already tired of knowing, I [u][b]work alone[/b][/u] on this project, so it turns out that failures and errors[/u] can often occur in the version that comes to you, I wanted to apologize for the old version [b]0.0.0.9[/b] which was more [u][b]unstable[/b][/u] than a bomb! But I believe this version has fixed most of the problems. So that you can understand the size of the problem:

Voodoo Business Multiplayer was made in just 3 months, I know it seems impossible but I did it, but of course in 3 months of work it is obvious that we will have 3 months of problems too, mainly problems with servers...

[u][b]HOWEVER...Version 0.0.1.0 has arrived to save the day ![/b][/u]

As usual, here is the list of fixes and changes made in this update (This is a big list for me) :


[h1]Update list 0.0.1.0 :[/h1]

[list]
[*] Version from Unreal Engine 4.26 to Unreal Engine 4.27

[*] New HUD

[*] New icons

[*] New unique songs

[*] New post processing

[*] Added weapon research system in the store

[*] Fixed bug not spawning in Family Business

[*] Fixed bug where buying weapons animations for the server are not working

[*] Fixed bug where settings reset all player progress

[*] Grenade sounds changed

[*] Grenades have their sound affected by the settings

[*] New Effects for Grenades

[*] Added weapon boost (Only in Voodoo Business for now)

[*] Ragdolls improvement

[*] Fixed issue with ammo being reset after reloading (If it persists, please report!)

[*] Headshots have a special sound (For now a mechanic from Voodoo Business)

[*] Crouch icon removed (Useless)

[*] HUD animation after changing shooting type

[*] German Lollipop now explodes instantly when touching anything

[*] Code optimization

[*] Correction of incorrect translations

[*] Fix for players not respawning

[*] Fixed issue with kill feed showing the wrong weapon

[*] Fixed bug where step particles spawn in everyone

[*] Shot collisions issue fixed

[*] Improved the kill feed that now shows different types of deaths

[*] Adding more weapons to bots

[*] Fixed infinite barriers glitch

[*] Fixed issue with bots not opening doors

[*] New loading system for maps

[*] Fixed songs ending and not playing anymore

[*] New songs in gamemodes

[*] Sun size decreased

[*] New weapon added (Cannoli)

[*] Fixed Voodoo Offering disappearing right after spawning

[*] Fixed the problem with names not appearing after two powers obtained in Voodoo Business

[*] Fixed server issues in Voodoo Business

[*] Improved game ending system in Voodoo Business, no longer requiring everyone to be dead, just knocked down

[*] Fixed issue with HUD not disappearing for the Client in Voodoo Business when the match ends

[*] Fixed the issue with the nuclear siren stop button only working for the Server

[*] Reduced spawn time

[*] Fixed issue with life not being restored in Family Business

[*] Improved low health heartbeat system

[*] New designs in the Main Menu

[*] New ammo tables for both teams

[*] Changes of various textures across maps, for example the barriers from Voodoo Business

[*] Readjusted doors
[/list]

There were a lot of things fixed but still, there must definitely be some other bugs out there...Anyway, here's a photo of the new weapon and the new ammo stocks :

[h2]Cannoli the newest weapon of Family Business![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312675/7e841a877d08acfa8222528c88508363b590e664.png[/img]

A classic revolver ! Good for killing a drug lord and a corrupt cop in a restaurant! This little revolver is so portable and easy to use that you can even hide it in the bathroom! With 5 bullets for 5 different problems and rapid fire, it's only a matter of time before your problems disappear !

[h3]You can now purchase Cannoli from the smuggler for as little as: [spoiler]$8000[/spoiler][/h3]

[h2]New ammunition stocks![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312675/c19406bd43f3d3674f40eb2741d9998e5eb08a4d.png[/img]

This is the new police ammunition stock, more organized, cleaner, more similar to what the law actually requires !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312675/cd7ee7f9def9c4f5107bf9e334b9b0a253b12904.png[/img]

This is the mob's new ammunition stash, messier, dirtier, more like what the law would prohibit !

[h1]Final Notes :[/h1]

After this update it should be easier to update Family Business, many things have been improved and that make my work easier, one of the best things was definitely changing the graphics engine version!

[h2]New release of Unreal Engine 4, what will this change ?[/h2]

Simply everything opens a new window of opportunities for new codes and mechanics, not to mention new plugins to be used. This version is more stable and less "bugged", meaning that problems that were common, such as server problems not appearing, are now resolved

[h2]What will be the next update ?[/h2]

Well, the next update will probably be correction, balancing and maybe it could include some new map for both game modes. As a result, this update was a watershed for Family Business, as it is more stable and makes it easier and more comfortable to launch new content such as maps and different game modes

[h2]When will we have animations for weapons ?[/h2]

I will be starting to develop the animations in the coming months, they will not necessarily be applied to the game, as quality is something we value a lot, so as many things are without animations we are in no rush to deliver something of good quality

[h2]When will we receive new content for Voodoo Business ?[/h2]

Soon there will be lots of new things from drinks, cigars, easter eggs, missions and bosses! But to do this, you must first build a good foundation of gameplay stability to prevent new mechanics from conflicting

Well mafiosos I think that's it ! My mission has been accomplished once again and I will see you soon! Feel free to ask anything or even send your ideas !

Enjoy !

-Don

notes.title: Family Business Maintenance
notes.notes:
Hello Mobsters !

Just stopping by to let you know that we are working hard to launch the update [b]0.0.1.0[/b] !

Many fixes are being made mainly in [u][b]Voodoo Business[/b][/u] which is experiencing various types of server problems. But you can rest assured that [b]a good part has already been fixed[/b] but, [u]we don't just want to release a fix update[/u], we are taking advantage of this time to [u][b]rework HUDS[/b][/u] as well as [u][b]optimizations[/b][/u] (Which are always a problem).

I would also like to inform you that in [b]April[/b] we will start working on [u]animations for the game's weapons[/u], so soon we will have animations for our much-loved weapons ! Being the first to receive animations : [b]The Gunfather[/b] and [b]American Pride[/b]

Our logic for animations will always be to make a [b]primary and a secondary[/b].

We are also preparing to launch in this version the possibility of [u][b]buying 4 Family Business keys[/b][/u] so it becomes easier to purchase and play with your friends !

We are also preparing a [u][b]game expansion[/b][/u] with [u]Golden Skins as well as a Skin for the game's characters[/u] just as extra support for development. [u]I'm not the biggest fan of additional paid content[/u] however, these are support issues only. I assure all of you that [u][b]NEVER[/b][/u] we will release significant content and updates such as maps, weapons, etc as a paid [u][b]DLC[/b][/u] ( Additional Content ). It would be [b]unethical[/b] to do that !

But that's it, my dear henchmens ! I'll be back soon with more updates and new information about the project ! I'm sorry for the problems that occurred, but rest assured that everything will be rewarded !

With love

- Don

notes.title: Voodoo Business Multiplayer
notes.notes:
[b]Hello mobsters![/b]

This long-awaited update has finally arrived ! I'm very proud to say that Family Business now has multiplayer in Voodoo Business mode !

Many things were changed in this update, but mainly optimization:

[u][b]Family Business 0.0.0.8 -> 20GB

Family Business 0.0.0.9 -> 10 GB[/b][/u]

So we are increasingly working to achieve perfection !

Other major changes were made, below is the list :

[b][list]
[*] Reduction in the size of Family Business
[*] Voodoo Business Multiplayer
[*] Improved game graphics
[*] All weapons have been reworked
[*] All weapons have more sounds (Capsules falling to the ground and loading sound)
[*] Improvement in game audio
[*] Correction of only being able to change the game sound using the Master volume
[*] Addition of a new map in Voodoo Business: Kobralyn
[*] General optimizations
[*] Reworked Voodoo Business AI
[*] New HUD for Voodoo Business
[*] Voodoo Business Powers now have audio when collected
[/list][/b]

And so many other game improvements !

I know it took a while for this update to come out but absolutely EVERYTHING had to be redone from scratch so that explains the delay in this update.

I also want to talk to you about 2 other things :

The [u][b]first[/b][/u] is that I'm going to take [b]3 months off[/b] (No need to cry, I'll be back) to rest a little after all the coding done from 0 and implementation of new mechanics, however I will be attentive to everything you report and if it is something very emergency I will work remotely to correct the problem! So I thank you all for everything! Without you Family Business would not exist

The [u][b]second[/b][/u] thing is simple: [b]MERRY CHRISTMAS![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312675/692e4f66cffbb2c68690194c03a4c7596192306f.jpg[/img]

Santa brought us this update and enjoyed a "little" with our beloved fellas ! So if you don't receive a gift this Christmas, it's not the mafia's fault, it's the whiskey's !

[h1]Future of Family Business[/h1]

As I will be away for 3 months I will already prepare two announcements for the next two big events: Family Business Anniversary and New Year

This 0.0.0.9 update will be the last major update of this year, but next year will be a year mainly of new content as the Family Business base is now ready !

Just to give you a little idea of ​​what's to come: Animations for weapons (Yes, you heard [or read] it right)

Once again, I can only thank all of you who are part of this story in my life !

[h2]Thank you and enjoy![/h2]

[h3]Email: Contact.FamilyBusiness@gmail.com[/h3]

-Don

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312675/2ee0f9d01e5b2a680c17b238128b01cf3fd17a7a.png[/img]

notes.title: Small update on Hud
notes.notes:
Hello mobsters !

This small update brings some bug fixes but mainly a new [u][b]HUD[/b][/u] to join servers and more match options !

Below is the list of fixes and improvements :

[b][list]
[*] New Hud in server list
[*] Added private servers
[*] LAN addition
[*] Added new tips and comments
[*] Improved HUD positioning
[*] Fixed some weapons having their names wrong
[*] Fixed "Restore" button not correctly restoring purchases
[/list][/b]

I know it seems like a small thing, but it's a big step forward because many of our updates are visualizing the future of [u][b]Family Business with community workshops[/b][/u]. I know that many people may be confused by changing versions so quickly but it is a way of guaranteeing our [u]quality[/u].

Recently I know that many must be strange [u]sometimes losing all progress[/u], the reason for this is that the save files are reset when there is an [u][b]update in the weapons codes[/b][/u], because with a new balance it could cause some [b]instabilities in servers[/b], but I guarantee that already we are working on a solution to this problem and I can even talk about this solution, that involves the [b]Steam Inventory System[/b], since information and purchases made in the game can be stored permanently, but until then we will work using the [b]Steam Cloud[/b] functionality (not yet implemented ) . I'm sorry if you missed a lot of progress, but for now in " [u][b]Early Access[/b][/u] " it's difficult to guarantee that there won't be such [u]sudden changes[/u].

I know there were few changes but our focus is to improve the code more and more, thus making our work speed increase a lot. The update was aimed at Huds, however this is just a measure to go on to the next challenge, walk or whatever you prefer that will be the addition of new maps, this takes time and a lot of resources so we are trying to update and fix as many bugs as possible in this right now because the more maps and modes we add the more fixes and bugs will be coming, so to minimize instabilities these are our decisions in updates.

Thank you all and we will continue to update Family Business as soon as possible ! In our next big update will be a map called " [b]Bocotown[/b] " which will be for Family Business mode !

Have a good game !

- Don

Remember Family Business still has some limitations and certainly the biggest one being the [b]" [u]Region Limitation[/u] "[/b] problem as this prevents some countries from being able to play together and since Family Business sales are all over the world it's a bit complicated...however I promise to solve this problem at some point ! But don't be discouraged, there are always BOTS to console our hearts...

Another important thing to mention is that in the new newsfeed (which is what I wanted to talk to you about) there is a big news: [b]You can announce your idea or project in the Family Business newsfeed! Just get in touch and we'll talk.[/b]

Mobsters any bug , problem or suggestion please contact us or even report below this update so we stay aware of everything that happens with Family Business !

I wish you all a great game and let's go for more updates to come! I hope you like the new version and don't forget to review the game, it helps us a lot !

- Don

notes.title: An irrecusable update !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312675/8081703a3fd6e784de57b868589414ec737f1ecc.png[/img]


Our first major update for Family Business:

[b]- Bug fixes
- Improved code optimization for developers
- Fixed not having Game Over on zombies
- Fix for being able to select a character in zombies
- Fixed being able to show the score on zombies
- Map improvement in zombies
- Adjustments in Nav Mesh (Place where the AI ​​can go)
- Weapon balancing (Damage and Recoil)
- Adjustment of values ​​in store items[/b]

I know that for many it seems little, but remember that Family Business is only done by one person! Some may even find it strange that I often speak in the plural , but the reason for that is simple , everyone who likes Family Business is part of the game 's production , because without the Family Business community it is nothing , that 's why we always ask you to send us an email talking about bugs , ideas , tips , whatever we want to hear what you have to say about Family Business !

A peek into the future that's coming for Family Business in the year 2023:

- WEAPONS RELOADING ANIMATION (Nobody deserves not to have animation)
- Multiplayer on zombies
- Small campaigns/missions in single player
- Customization of both character and weapons
- New maps for both classic Family Business mode and zombies
- New gamemodes ( Free For All , Capture the Flag , Kill Confirmed , Gun Game , ETC )

And so many other news are yet to come , but with this little peek into the future , you can already imagine what is to come for this project !

I thank everyone who is part of my story! I've always wanted to make games and now it's becoming a reality so I'll never give up working regardless of the results I get! Dream , Believe and Realize !

Thank you for understanding and good game everyone!

- Don
